shift

(noun). sự dịch chuyển, sự chuyển đổi

Ex: A gradual shift towards renewable energy would mean reduced carbon emissions.

trigger

(verb). gây ra, làm nổ ra

Ex: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.

state

(noun). Trạng thái

Ex: He was in a state of permanent depression.

linear

(adjective). tuyến tính, thẳng hàng

Ex: Students do not always progress in a linear fashion.

publish

(verb). công bố

Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

relate

(verb). liên hệ, liên kết

Ex: I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

interpersonal

(adjective). giữa cá nhân với nhau

Ex: The successful applicant will have excellent interpersonal skills.

neural

(adjective). liên quan đến thần kinh

Ex: Some people suffered severe neural damage as a result of the disease.

trust

(noun). sự tin tưởng

Ex: Our partnership is based on trust.

network

(noun). mạng lưới

Ex: Europe's mobile phone networks are controlled by five dominant players.

demand

(verb). yêu cầu, đòi hỏi

Ex: This is a very difficult piece of music to play - it demands a lot of concentration.

intuitively

(adverb). Bằng trực giác, qua trực giác

Ex: Intuitively, she knew that he was lying.

psychologist

(noun). Nhà tâm lý học

Ex: I made an appointment with the school psychologist

analyse

(verb). phân tích, đánh giá

Ex: He tried to analyse his feelings.

assess

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.

conscious

(adjective). có nhận thức

Ex: She's very conscious of the problems involved.

evaluate

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

put into practice

(verb). thực hành, đem áp dụng vào thực tiễn

Ex: Her advice is good, but it's hard to put into practice.

upgrade

(verb). Nâng cấp

Ex: We are constantly upgrading our software to meet customers' needs.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

Ex: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

elaboration

(noun). sự giải thích, sự làm công phu

Ex: This point needs greater elaboration.

inspiration

(noun). Cảm hứng

Ex: Dreams can be a rich source of inspiration for an artist.

arousal

(noun). sự khơi gợi, sự khuấy động

Ex: The intensity of a dream is a measure of emotional arousal.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm, thí nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

laidback

(adjective). thư giãn

Ex: He loved the laid-back Caribbean lifestyle.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

signal

(noun). tín hiệu

Ex: The rise in inflation is a clear signal that the government's policies are not working.

perceive

(verb). nhận thức

Ex: This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.

stage

(noun). giai đoạn

Ex: This technology is still in its early stages.

strikingly

(adverb). một cách nổi bật

Ex: The two polls produced strikingly different results.

sections.title: Passage 3: Monkeys and Forests
sections.html:
aim

(verb). ngắm

Ex: I was aiming at the tree but hit the car by mistake.

canopy

(noun). tán, vòm

Ex: The canopy of a rainforest is about 10 metres thick.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột, mâu thuẫn

Ex: The story tells of a classic conflict between love and duty.

conservation

(noun). Sự bảo tồn

Ex: Road development in the area has been severely affected by the conservation programmes of the council.

crop

(noun). cây trồng

Ex: The crops are regularly sprayed with pesticides.

defense

(noun). sự phòng thủ

Ex: They are responsible for maintaining coastal flood defenses.

disperse

(verb). Phân tán

Ex: The seeds are dispersed by the wind.

ecologist

(noun). Nhà sinh thái học

Ex: This course is for anyone wanting to become a professional ecologist.

evolve

(verb). Tiến hoá

Ex: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.

fertilize

(verb). làm cho phì nhiêu, làm cho màu mỡ

Ex: You have to fertilize your garden.

indigestible

(adjective). không tiêu hóa được

Ex: Beans can be rather indigestible.

infinite

(adjective). vô hạn

Ex: The universe is theoretically infinite.

modify

(verb). Điều chỉnh

Ex: Patients are taught how to modify their diet.

myriad

(adjective). vô số

Ex: They offered no solution for all our myriad problems.

pasture

(noun). đồng cỏ

Ex: The sheep were grazing on the lush green pastures.

preserve

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

Ex: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.

render

(verb). làm cho

Ex: Hundreds of people were rendered homeless by the earthquake.

reproduce

(verb). sinh sản

Ex: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.

rugged

(adjective). gồ ghề

Ex: The countryside around here is very rugged.

tolerate

(verb). Khoan dung, tha thứ

Ex: This sort of behaviour will not be tolerated.

track

(verb). theo dõi

Ex: We continued tracking the plane on our radar.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

vision

(noun). tầm nhìn

Ex: Our job is to guide a client and develop a strategic vision.

wobble

(verb). lắc lư, lảo đảo

Ex: The vase wobbled and then crashed to the ground.

fell

(verb). đốn chặt

Ex: Trees were felled and floated downstream.

rate

(noun). Tốc độ

Ex: Most people walk at an average rate of five kilometres an hour.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

habitat

(noun). Môi trường sống

Ex: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.

forest

(noun). rừng rậm

Ex: Thousands of hectares of forest are destroyed each year.

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

survive

(verb). Sống sót, tồn tại

Ex: They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

population

(noun). Dân số

Ex:The country has a total population of 65 million.

vanish

(verb). Biến mất

Ex: Much of the land we loved has vanished forever.

primate

(noun). động vật linh trưởng

Ex: One of the world's most diverse primates, lemurs range in size from a mouse to a medium-size dog.

actually

(adverb). thực sự

Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.

limited

(adjective). bị giới hạn

Ex: We have limited choices

regenerate

(verb). phục hưng, tái sinh

Ex: The money will be used to regenerate the commercial heart of the town.

undisturbed

(adjective). yên tĩnh

Ex: The treasure had lain undisturbed for centuries.

diet

(noun). Chế độ ăn uống

Ex: I loved the Japanese diet of rice, vegetables and fish.

mention

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: He made no mention of her work.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

available

(adjective). có sẵn

Ex: We'll send you a copy as soon as it becomes available.

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Ex: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater for the needs of everyone.

persist

(verb). Vẫn còn, cứ dai dẳng

Ex: The belief that the earth was flat persisted for many centuries.

associate

(verb). Kết giao, liên hợp, liên kết

Ex: I don't like you associating with those people.

attitude

(noun). Thái độ

Ex: If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!

ecotourism

(noun). du lịch sinh thái

Ex: Costa Rica's national parks have made it a center for ecotourism.

potential

(adjective). Tiềm năng

Ex: We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.

flexibility

(noun). Tính linh hoạt

Ex: The new system offers a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.

fragment

(verb). làm vỡ vụn, vỡ vụn

Ex: The satellite will fragment and burn up as it falls through the earth's atmosphere.

huge

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.

occupy

(verb). chiếm đóng, cư ngụ

Ex: Protesting students occupied the university office for two weeks.

resilient

(adjective). Kiên cường, có sức chống chịu cao

Ex: He'll get over it—young people are amazingly resilient.

segment

(verb). chia đoạn, phân đoạn

Ex: Market researchers often segment the population on the basis of age and social class.

agriculture

(noun). Ngành nông nghiệp

Ex: The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.

alter

(verb). làm thay đổi

Ex: His actions that day altered my perception of him.

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

cultivate

(verb). cày cấy, trồng trọt

Ex: The land around here has never been cultivated.

ecology

(noun). Ngành sinh thái học

Ex: We were leaning about ecology in our biology class and this involved a trip to Dublin Zoo.

exotic

(adjective). kỳ lạ, ngoại lai

Ex: The fruits sound exotic. Do they taste good?

plantation

(noun). Đồn điền

Ex: Hundreds of slaves used to work on the plantations.

recently

(adverb). gần đây

Ex: She recently completed a follow-up study of participants.

thrive

(verb). Phát triển mạnh

Ex: New businesses thrive in this area.

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

Ex: You should gain some valuable insights into the world of business.

original

(adjective). Nguyên bản, khởi nguồn

Ex: The room still has many of its original features.

mature

(verb). trưởng thành; hoàn thiện

Ex: Technology in this field has matured considerably over the last decade.

ability

(noun). khả năng, năng lực

Ex: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

absorb

(verb). Hấp thụ

Ex: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.

alleviate

(verb). Giảm nhẹ

Ex: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.

deadly

(adjective). gây chết người, chí mạng

Ex: The cobra is one of the world's deadliest snakes.

defuse

(verb). xoa dịu

Ex: These latest measures should help to defuse the situation.

detoxify

(verb). giải độc

Ex: You can help your body detoxify by cutting down on coffee.

exposure

(noun). sự tiếp xúc

Ex: You should always limit your exposure to the sun.

handle

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.

nutrient

(noun). Chất dinh dưỡng

Ex: Plants draw minerals and other nutrients from the soil.

poison

(noun). chất độc

Ex: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.

bear

(verb). sinh, sinh sản

Ex: Most animals bear their young in the spring.

compare

(verb). so sánh

Ex: We compared the two reports carefully.

give birth

(verb). sinh, đẻ

Ex: Mary gave birth to a healthy baby girl.

infant

(noun). Trẻ sơ sinh

Ex: She was seriously ill as an infant.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

content

(noun). Lượng, phân lượng

Ex: Chocolate has a high fat content.

plenty

(pronoun). Vô vàn

Ex: ‘Do we need more milk?’ ‘No, there's plenty in the fridge.’

stream

(noun). suối

Ex: Our rivers and streams are polluted with a host of chemicals.

drought

(noun). Hạn hán

Ex: England has had several summer droughts in recent years.

ongoing

(adjective). tiếp diễn

Ex: Training is part of our ongoing career development program.

resist

(verb). cưỡng lại, kháng lại

Ex: They are determined to resist pressure to change the law.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.
